title: monthlyfiscalcalendar
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, salespersonid, transactioncurrencyid.

createdon.description: Date and time when the quota for the monthly fiscal calendar was modified.

effectiveon.description: Date and time when the monthly fiscal calendar sales quota takes effect.

exchangerate.description: Exchange rate for the currency associated with the monthly fiscal calendar with respect to the base currency.

fiscalperiodtype.description: Type of fiscal period used in the sales quota.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the quota for the monthly fiscal calendar was last modified.

month1.description: Sales quota for the first month in the fiscal year.
